claims.claim: Intersect requests $298,250, equivalent to 1,193,000 ADA, to support TSC activities for 12 months.
The budget is allocated as 256,000 ADA for WP1, 832,000 ADA for WP2, and 105,000 ADA for WP3.
WP2 funds the Parameter Committee, CIP editors, and Hard Fork Working Group.
WP3 funds a pilot independent technical review programme launching in 2027 with conflict-of-interest provisions, published recusals, and open reviewer selection against documented criteria.
All expenditure will be fully accounted for and any unspent funds returned to the Cardano treasury.
Execution of the work packages is contingent on approval of the IntersectMBO budget proposal.
The proposal achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
The requested amount did not, at submission, breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.

Independent audits and assurance for the proposal will be provided by Appold, with possible reviews including deliverable verification, control testing, spend validation, and milestone evidence assessment.

Intersect will administer the withdrawn funds through Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with specified TRSC and PSSC addresses, oversight entities, authorization thresholds, and a public dashboard.

summary: The document requests 1,193,000 ADA for 12 months of TSC support, gives a three-work-package budget, identifies smart contract custody and oversight mechanisms, cites external references for voting and smart-contract materials, and includes several governance and accountability commitments that are mostly asserted rather than evidenced in the anchor text.
